precepts.text: Put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof. To make provision is to make a way for you to fulfil that lust, to leave doors open for that sin. Why be on the phone with your ex? If you are struggling, delete the apps; put controls on your phone so you cannot go on certain things. People say, I made a mistake, I slipped and fell. No: there was planning, you were talking first, you planned what day to meet up; it was already in your mind. It was a decision, not a mistake. If it is that bad, get rid of social media. Do not say, I can handle it, I am good; that is Satan telling you that, and leaving it open keeps fueling that lust.
precepts.point: Sexual discipline applies inside marriage too. When your wife gives birth, you have to wait forty days, sometimes eighty. When your wife is in her seven days you cannot touch her. And guess what: Satan does not come when you are dealing with your woman; he comes when you are not getting any. That is where the fight starts. So those days are the days you get closer to the Lord: I am going to fast more, I am going to occupy myself with the Lord. That is how you train yourself to have sexual discipline. As men we cannot let pleasure control us.

note.label: Sexual Discipline

precepts.why:
“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” What does it mean to walk in the Spirit? It does not mean moonwalking or walking on the air. Romans explains it: “But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ”, that is, the commandments and your faith, “and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.” To make provision for the flesh is not walking in the Spirit.

To make provision is to make a way for you to fulfil that lust, leaving doors open for the sin. Why are you on the phone with your ex? You are going to end up banging her. If you are struggling, delete Instagram and delete certain things; put controls on your phone so you cannot go on certain things. People say, I made a mistake, I slipped and fell, I don't know what happened. So you were walking and just slipped and fell on the dude? There was planning. You were talking to him first, and you planned what day to meet up. It was already in your mind. It was a decision, not a mistake.

With porn, if it is that bad, get rid of social media. Do not say, I can handle it, I'm good. That is Satan telling you that, and leaving it open keeps fuelling the lust, because every time you go on you see a bunch of different stuff. Some of you say you repented but leave little doors open, and you fall back into that sin. Sit down and talk to yourself: I am dealing with this, so I need to set things up so I do not fall into it.

Because “the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”. It is a war: you want to stop, you stop for a week or two, and it comes back. The works of the flesh are “Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness”, all sexual sins. That discipline applies in marriage too: forty or eighty days after your wife gives birth, and her seven days. Satan does not come when you are dealing with your woman; he comes when you are not getting any. Those are the days to fast more and occupy yourself with the Lord. As men we cannot let pleasure control us.

precepts.text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another: you try to agitate the brother to play him out of position because you are envious, to provoke him to do evil to justify your position against him. We see it even in marriage: a brother provokes his wife, she leaves out of the house and does something foolish, and he says, I told you the sister was off. No, brother; you provoked your wife.
precepts.point: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: this is the deception. He acted like his friend, talked with him over a period of time, and lured him out to the field. And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him. That is the spirit you are rolling in when you move with that bitter spirit; in that wrath you will slay a brother, or in that bitterness you might betray a brother.

note.label: Bitterness: The Hidden Leaven From Cain To Esau

precepts.why:
“Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.” Cain wanted to be the man; that is vain glory.

Provoking one another means agitating a brother to play him out of position, because you are envious of him. You do something to provoke him to evil so you can justify your position against him.

We see this even in marriage. A brother provokes his wife, she leaves the house and does something foolish, and he sits back saying, I told you the sister was off, I told you she was evil. No, brother: you are the evil one, you provoked your wife. We are not going for that foolishness here. Envy provokes, and provoking is how the bitter spirit sets up its victim.

precepts.text: The law is spiritual, but I am carnal, sold under sin. To stop being carnal, keep the law.
precepts.point: The camp is not small any more. A brother making a delivery in another state got recognized by someone outside the truth. If he had been doing wickedness, that is how easily it gets found out.

note.label: Covetous Eyes Will Be Put Out

precepts.why:
“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” What is the Spirit you have to walk in so that you never do amiss? “For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.” The law is spiritual. We are carnal, sold under sin. So if we want to stop being carnal and stop sinning, we have to keep the law.

That is what walking in the Spirit means: walking in the ordinances, the laws, the statutes and the commandments of the Lord God. If you are doing these things, you are never going to do amiss.

“For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”. There is a war within you. The old man always wants to be around, in your business: reading the Bible? You don't need to read the Bible. Let's go rob a house, steal a car, boost cars like you used to, call your man for two birds, go fly some kites. The only way you win this war is by actually reading your Bible and applying what you read.

If you do not read, pray or fast, miss all the new moons and feast days, and show up on the Sabbath just to keep up appearances, you will not be able to fight the lust within your flesh, because you are not walking in the Spirit. The flesh will always be present; it is what you put in you now that fights it. So stay in this book, the spiritual law, and the carnal man is subdued.

precepts.text: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing. The words I speak unto you are spirit and life.
precepts.point: The camp is not small any more. A brother making a delivery in another state got recognized by someone outside the truth. If he had been doing wickedness, that is how easily it gets found out.

note.label: Covetous Eyes Will Be Put Out

precepts.why:
“It is the spirit that quickeneth”: only the spirit can change you as a man. “the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.” So when Galatians says walk in the Spirit, it means walk in the words of Christ, the laws, statutes and commandments, and you will not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

Those words have to live in you. The Bible should be like the receptionist at the front desk of an office building: nobody gets in unless she lets them. The door to your soul is your forehead, so the Bible should sit there. When the plan comes up, it says, I hear you, but that's two to five; that's ten to fifteen; that's life. Thou shalt not steal.

When you see a beautiful woman and are tempted to start rubbernecking, you remember Job: I made a covenant with my eyes, why then should I think upon a maid? If you walk in a place and there's a stack of money with nobody around, thou shalt not steal. Without the scriptures readily in your mind, it is impossible not to fall into temptation.

And hidden wickedness does not stay hidden. We are not small any more. A brother making a delivery from another state was recognized by someone not even in the truth. Imagine if he had been doing wickedness. The words of Christ are spirit and life; the flesh profits nothing.

precepts.text: Add to your faith virtue, knowledge, temperance, patience, godliness, brotherly kindness, charity. Knowledge means learning to break the scriptures down, because the camp will not be on social media forever, and a brother who will not come around the deacons and bishops to learn will not last. If these things be in you and abound, ye shall be neither barren nor unfruitful; abound means they stay, because a brother of seven years with green leaves can be offended and stop bearing fruit. He that lacketh these things is blind and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
precepts.point: Against such there is no law, because you are keeping the law. These are the fruits that develop once the word dwells in you.

note.label: A Tree Bearing No Fruits

precepts.why:
“But the fruit of the Spirit is love”: keeping the commandments. Joy: do you have joy in keeping God's commandments, or are you always sad and depressed? Peace with your wife and with the brothers and sisters, not always arguing and fighting. Longsuffering is patience. Gentleness means being right with your brother; it does not mean you have to be soft and act like a sodomite. Faith is believing what the Bible says. Temperance is self-control, not easily provoked. “against such there is no law”, because you are keeping the law. These fruits develop once the word of God dwells in you.

Peter shows the same fruits: “And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge”. Knowledge means learning the scriptures and learning how to break them down, because we are not going to be on social media all the time. Brothers who will not come around the deacons, bishops and officers to learn the knowledge of God are not going to last in this truth. “And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness; And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity”: loving God with all your heart and your brother as yourself. All of these are the fruits your tree must bring forth.

“For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.” Abound means they stay in you. These things can be in you and then leave you. A brother or sister can be among us six or seven years, growing, the leaves green, and then somebody offends them and all of a sudden they stop bearing fruit.

“But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.” So examine yourself: am I bearing good fruit? The Lord does not tell you how long he will be patient. A fig tree that bears no fruit is cut down, and a branch that does not abide in Christ withers and is cast into the fire.

precepts.text: The works of the flesh that we were dead in are made manifest.
precepts.point: He prays, teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God; thy spirit is good. The will of the Most High is to keep His commandments, and His spirit is the word.

note.label: Psalm 143: Seeking the Old Paths in Affliction

precepts.why: “Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness”. The works of the flesh that we were dead in are made manifest. The flesh profiteth nothing; it is the spirit, the word, that quickens, and it leads into the land of uprightness away from these works.
